reviews.review_msg: Christian is nice, very funny and he is a fair marker. His tests are straight forward, study his powerpoint notes and do the practice questions he gives out for the exams and you should be fine. He may take long to respond to emails but see him in person, he's always available to help.

History of racist microaggressions. Okay prof but long lectures and hella readings. Finals workload was TOUGH. One group research project but a) had to present it + b) had to write an essay for it; one final exam with a) an at-home components + b) in-person essay. So much longer + worse than it should've been. RMP is glitching: would NOT take again
